persona_and_vibe.theme: Dark / Obsidian Command Center with Amber/Gold & Emerald Precision Accents
persona_and_vibe.tone: Subtle luxury, intense focus, stealth wealth, high intelligence, institutional power
persona_and_vibe.vibe_description: Fortune 007 combines the sleek tactical feel of an executive flight deck with intelligence tools. Dark slate/obsidian backdrop (#090D16, #0F172A), sharp 1px hairline glass borders, glowing indicator dots, gold/emerald accents for key financial and operational metrics.

typography.h1_style: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-100

layout_and_pillars.grid_system: High Density Responsive Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 for Pillar tiles; side-by-side workspace layout with 280px left tool panel, main canvas flex-1, and 360px collapsible AI chat sidebar.

pillars.name: TaxDesk
pillars.tagline: GST Intelligence, Invoice AI & PDF Exporter

pillars.name: MarketPulse
pillars.tagline: Real-time Business News & Market Signal Radar

component_guidelines.header_nav: Fixed glassmorphic command header with blurred dark backdrop (bg-[#080B11]/90 backdrop-blur-xl), z-50, displaying logo badge 'FORTUNE 007', pillar quick switcher, admin toggle, and user profile drawer.
component_guidelines.pillar_tile: Bento-style visual card with glowing hover stroke, status indicator dot, key metrics counter, quick launch button, and data-testid attributes.
component_guidelines.pillar_workspace: Split view containing tool workspace (60-70% width) and dedicated AI chat side panel (30-40% width) tailored to that specific pillar context.
component_guidelines.admin_console: Dedicated full-screen modal or view with tabs for AI Settings (Gemini API key & model), TinyFish Research settings (base URL & API key), User Directory table, and Suite Telemetry stats.
component_guidelines.gst_calculator: Interactive inputs for taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown, inclusive/exclusive radio toggle, AI invoice extraction trigger, and crisp PDF generator export button.
component_guidelines.email_composer: AI template generator + real email dispatch interface (with SMTP API / email trigger simulation & real toast alert).
component_guidelines.toast: Use Sonner from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx for high-visibility dark alerts.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, inputs, buttons, tables, pillar links, modal triggers, and key stats MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format. E.g. data-testid='venture-radar-card', data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='gst-calculate-btn', data-testid='ai-chat-input'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components use .jsx / .js format as existing in frontend codebase.
Implement Firebase auth flow with fallback mock auth and admin passcode 1111/1111 for rapid testing.
Store Gemini and TinyFish config in persistent local state / backend config.
Ensure seamless responsive behavior on tablet and desktop.
Provide crisp feedback with Sonner toast on email sending, PDF downloads, invoice extractions, and AI chat responses.
